title: Labels
purpose: Check the labels for the chosen specimens before downloading them as a PDF.
summary: Check the labels for the chosen specimens before downloading them as a PDF.

tasks.title: Print the labels
steps: Check each label, then select [[Download PDF]]. There is one page per label, in the order shown.

tasks.title: Choose other specimens
steps: Go back to the specimen list, tick them and select Print labels.
For another group from the same import, select the file name above the page title and choose the next range.

good_to_know: A label shows only the specimen ID, as text and as a Code 128 barcode.
Up to 200 labels at a time. A specimen listed twice prints twice.
A label marked Does not fit needs a larger label stock, which is a deployment setting.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Each label shows the specimen ID as text and as a Code 128 barcode, and nothing else: no participant, collection, location or date. The ID is the only link between the physical tube and the record. The page header shows the number of labels and the label stock (name, version and size in millimetres) the PDF will use; print at actual size.

Every staff role can open labels from a specimen record or the specimen list. Administrators, managers and technicians can also open labels directly from a committed import. The import preview identifies the range of specimens in file order. Select the file name above the title to return to the import.

items.label: Download PDF
items.description: Produces one page per label, in the order shown. A specimen listed twice is printed twice (a reprint). Each successful download is logged with the specimen IDs, count and label stock. Printing a label changes nothing about the specimen and does not record that a label was attached to a tube. If the PDF cannot be produced you return here with a message.

sections.title: Limits and errors
paragraphs: From a specimen list or record, choose between 1 and 200 labels. If the selection is empty, exceeds the limit or includes a missing specimen, No labels to preview gives the reason. Choose specimens returns to the list. If an imported specimen is missing, select the file name above the title to return to the import.

A label whose ID cannot fit the stock is marked Does not fit with the reason, and Download PDF is not offered until the problem is solved; this means a larger label stock is needed, which is a deployment setting.
